basic_details.job_title: APDCL Consumer Representative Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: APDCL has invited applications for appointment to the post of Consumer Representative (APDCL's nominated), a member of the State Level CGRF (Consumer Grievances Redressal Forum), under Employment Notice No. MD/APDCL/HR/CGRF/REC/200 dated 06/11/2026. Applications in the prescribed format (Annexure I) go in hard copy only to the O/o the CGM (HRA), APDCL, Bijulee Bhawan, Paltanbazar, Ghy-781001, and the last date of receipt is 30 November 2026.

qualification.details: The post is Consumer Representative (APDCL's nominated), a member of the State Level CGRF. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The eligibility conditions printed in the notice are: | The member shall not be in employment of the distribution licensee (APDCL) or any of its agencies, in any capacity, for a period of three years preceding the date of being appointed as member of the Forum. The member should have good antecedents. The member should not have any outstanding dues of electricity or cases pending with APDCL during the time of appointment. Desirable: members of CGRF are well conversant with the official language of the State. | No member shall hold office after attaining the age of 70 (Seventy) years. The notice gives no other age limit. | The nominated members of the State Level Forum are entitled to a sitting fee of Rs. 3000/- for every sitting of the Forum. This amount may be revised by the Commission (AERC) in consultation with APDCL from time to time. The nominated Members are also entitled to conveyance allowance for attending the official duties of the Forum. | The duties and responsibilities are as stipulated in the Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission (Redressal of Consumer Grievances) Regulations, 2022, as amended from time to time by AERC/Competent Authority. Every nominated member holds office for a term of three years from the date of entry into the office. A selected Member will be given short notice to join in the respective office. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

important_instructions: No person shall be appointed, or continue as a member, if disqualified on account of: having been adjudged an insolvent; having been convicted of an offence which, in the opinion of APDCL, involves moral turpitude; having become physically or mentally incapable of acting as such member. Also disqualified: having acquired such financial or other interest as is likely to affect prejudicially the functions as a representative; having so abused the position as to render continuance in office prejudicial to public interest; or having been guilty of proved misbehavior. An existing member is liable to be removed from office on account of any of these disqualifications arising or being discovered, after following due process of law. If at any stage it is detected that a candidate has submitted false information, the candidature will be rejected forthwith. Bringing influence at any stage of the selection process will disqualify the candidature with immediate effect. APDCL reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process for the post without assigning any reasons.

content_sections.heading: About APDCL
content_sections.text: APDCL is a distribution licensee whose office of the Chief General Manager (HRA) is at Bijulee Bhawan, Guwahati. The State Level CGRF is the forum that hears consumer grievances, and its work is governed by the Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission (Redressal of Consumer Grievances) Regulations, 2022. This notice fills the seat of the Consumer Representative that APDCL nominates to the Forum.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria may send their application in the prescribed format (Annexure I) in hard copy only to this address: O/o the CGM (HRA), APDCL, Bijulee Bhawan, Paltanbazar, Ghy-781001 Use only the prescribed format, Annexure I. Applications not submitted as per format will be rejected. The application form must be received by 30 November 2026. The notice does not mention the postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The post is Consumer Representative (APDCL's nominated), a member of the State Level CGRF. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The eligibility conditions printed in the notice are: The member shall not be in employment of the distribution licensee (APDCL) or any of its agencies, in any capacity, for a period of three years preceding the date of being appointed as member of the Forum. The member should have good antecedents. The member should not have any outstanding dues of electricity or cases pending with APDCL during the time of appointment. Desirable: members of CGRF are well conversant with the official language of the State. No member shall hold office after attaining the age of 70 (Seventy) years. The notice gives no other age limit. The nominated members of the State Level Forum are entitled to a sitting fee of Rs. 3000/- for every sitting of the Forum. This amount may be revised by the Commission (AERC) in consultation with APDCL from time to time. The nominated Members are also entitled to conveyance allowance for attending the official duties of the Forum. The duties and responsibilities are as stipulated in the Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission (Redressal of Consumer Grievances) Regulations, 2022, as amended from time to time by AERC/Competent Authority. Every nominated member holds office for a term of three years from the date of entry into the office. A selected Member will be given short notice to join in the respective office. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.text: No person shall be appointed, or continue as a member, if disqualified on account of: having been adjudged an insolvent; having been convicted of an offence which, in the opinion of APDCL, involves moral turpitude; having become physically or mentally incapable of acting as such member. Also disqualified: having acquired such financial or other interest as is likely to affect prejudicially the functions as a representative; having so abused the position as to render continuance in office prejudicial to public interest; or having been guilty of proved misbehavior. An existing member is liable to be removed from office on account of any of these disqualifications arising or being discovered, after following due process of law. If at any stage it is detected that a candidate has submitted false information, the candidature will be rejected forthwith. Bringing influence at any stage of the selection process will disqualify the candidature with immediate effect. APDCL reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process for the post without assigning any reasons.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the APDCL CGRF Consumer Representative post?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of the application form is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for APDCL Recruitment 2026 for the CGRF?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format (Annexure I) in hard copy only to the O/o the CGM (HRA), APDCL, Bijulee Bhawan, Paltanbazar, Ghy-781001. Applications not submitted as per format will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the sitting fee for the APDCL CGRF Consumer Representative?
faq.answer: Nominated members of the State Level Forum get a sitting fee of Rs. 3000/- for every sitting of the Forum, which may be revised by AERC in consultation with APDCL from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. Is any allowance paid besides the sitting fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Nominated Members are entitled to conveyance allowance for attending the official duties of the Forum.

faq.question: Q5. How will the APDCL CGRF Consumer Representative be selected?
faq.answer: Members are selected from the applications received against the advertisement, subject to fulfilling the eligibility in their respective category, with document verification of original documents if called for.

faq.question: Q6. Can a former APDCL employee apply?
faq.answer: The member shall not have been in employment of APDCL or any of its agencies, in any capacity, for three years preceding the date of being appointed as member of the Forum.

faq.question: Q7. Can a person with unpaid electricity dues be appointed?
faq.answer: No. The member should not have any outstanding dues of electricity or cases pending with APDCL during the time of appointment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the term of the APDCL CGRF Consumer Representative?
faq.answer: Every nominated member holds office for a term of three years from the date of entry into the office, and no Member shall hold office after attaining the age of 70 years.

faq.question: Q9. Is knowledge of the State's official language required?
faq.answer: It is desirable, not mandatory, that the members of CGRF are well conversant with the official language of the State.
